# Surface: research report website (site/, generated by src/trendlab/site)

Scope: GitHub Pages site for the trendlab research report. Mode: Read. Pages: index (verdict + six findings with proof charts + study index), ten study pages (e01-e10), methodology. Audience: quant recruiters and interviewers skimming a portfolio; verdict within a minute, evidence on demand. All numbers come from reports/results.json, tables and section JSON; nothing hard-coded. Hybrid charts: six interactive SVG charts (bias waterfall, SPY equity/drawdown, parameter heatmap, significance forest, SPY crises, multi-asset portfolio), remaining matplotlib PNGs as figures. Build path: code-led (Read surface). Direction chosen unattended: the user asked for no further questions after the initial round, so the decision page was not served.

## Direction contract

THESIS: A Tufte-school research handout where every number carries its provenance in the margin. It refuses the quant-portfolio default of KPI tiles over a dark hero, and the notebook dump.

OWN-WORLD: White bond page, near-black ink, ET Book (line figures) for prose and headings; a Helvetica-class grotesk, matching the chart labels, for tables, nav, sidenote labels and chart text at small sizes. Colour is confined to data: strategy blue #2a78d6, buy-and-hold grey #999891. One carmine annotation ink reserved for the v1 claim under examination and the bias each step removes. A wide right margin column holds sidenotes. Hairline rules only inside tables.
Raise (Swiss grid poster wall): one master grid governs all twelve pages, text column plus margin column; studies differ only by their figures.
Raise (patent drawing sheet): a single annotation ink is reserved for what is under examination, never decoration.
Raise (cutting bench): state is a mark, not a hue; each finding carries a typographic verdict mark (Artifact / Holds / Not significant / Robust), never colour-coded.
Raise (iridescent cloud edge): the text field stays achromatic; colour appears only where data is.

STORY: The reader sees the +505% claim struck through in carmine, the corrected +322% against buy-and-hold's +346%, then six findings each beside its proof chart, then opens any study, each ending with prev/next.

FIRST VIEWPORT: Running head across the top: project name and "Data through <date>" left, Findings / Studies / Methodology / Source right, small grotesk. Title in ET Book about 3rem: "An EMA crossover, honestly." Two-sentence standfirst in the text column. Below, the claim line at display size: carmine struck "+505%", an arrow, ink "+322%", grey "buy & hold +346%". The interactive bias waterfall spans text plus margin width directly beneath; its margin sidenote explains the step under the pointer.

FORM: candidate 3 of 7 (Tufte handout / scholarly apparatus). seed:e03fe507f1b5a0a3. Signature interaction: hovering or focusing any chart mark writes its exact values and provenance into the margin note beside it (inline readout on mobile). Motion: bars and lines draw once on first view in 400ms, disabled under reduced motion.

FINISH: unreviewed and undocumented is unfinished; this build ends with the finish review, the verdict, DESIGN.md, and every shipping raster carrying its provenance
